top_categories.workout_context: 73ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
GRUSK's West Virginia mountains, Mountain gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 82 miles.
At GRUSK, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GRUSK. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GRUSK's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before July.
At mile 60 of 82, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
6,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At GRUSK, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
6,000ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 82 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Low-cadence force work for 6,000ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on West Virginia mountain gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for GRUSK’s 65 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at GRUSK requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on west virginia mountain gravel to build confidence. Expect: west virginia mountains, mountain gravel, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and Over Under to prepare you for 82 miles of west virginia mountain gravel in Circleville, West Virginia.
